Therefore the cancel is out of order relative to the locked state and is silently dropped by the fold as a no-op rather than rejected outright. Final status remains locked, because no on-chain settlement has occurred yet (testnet-era: FLOP escrow must exist before value/state can move), and the cancel cannot unwind a lock that never hit chain.
